stories.title: Jamia's Department of Persian holds Hafez Shirazi commemoration with Iran's Culture House
stories.body: The Department of Persian at Jamia Millia Islamia held a Hafez Shirazi commemoration ceremony on Monday 12 October, in collaboration with the Culture House of the Islamic Republic of Iran, New Delhi, according to a university press release of the same date. The release says it took place in the department's Iranology Hall. Prof. Mohsin Ali, head of the department, welcomed guests. Dr. Fariduddin Farid Asr, the Culture House's Cultural Counsellor, was chief guest and spoke of India-Iran cultural and literary ties. Vice-Chancellor Prof. Mazhar Asif gave the presidential remarks. Students sang Hafez's ghazals and gave speeches.
stories.check: The release page shows no date or text; the event and release date of 12 October come from the English PDF (file name carries 2026October12). Single source: confirm with Jamia.
